Learners who can provide proof of instruction received at another school are eligible to begin at stage two. --[3]--.

A school car fitted with a second set of controls is supplied for every session, so no learner needs to bring a vehicle. In stage one, two learners share each car, taking turns at the wheel while the other observes. --[4]--.
Ready to start?
Complete the request form on our enrollment page, and the office will contact you to arrange a date for your first session.

Review of Foxton Cleaning Services
Rating: 5 out of 5 stars
Posted by Delia Marsh, October 14
I run a small shop where customers browse the shelves before leaving with two paperbacks. It closes for only two hours each afternoon, and I refuse to shut out paying customers. Any cleaning had to fit into that short break. A cafe owner across the street recommended Foxton Cleaning Services, which mostly serves cafes and dental practices. The gym next door, however, suggested the Overnight Service.
Foxton offers four packages. The Maintenance Plan and the Overnight Service serve weekly clients and large sites. The Deep Refresh is a thorough cleaning lasting most of a day. The Express Clean is the quickest package and costs slightly more per hour than the Deep Refresh. Faster work, I assumed, meant weaker results, so the slowest package seemed best.
When I called, the staff suggested the Maintenance Plan, but I booked the quickest package instead. Having seen the prices, I was not surprised by its higher hourly rate. Although the Deep Refresh was available that week, I have not regretted turning it down.
On the day of the cleaning, the crew was gone before I reopened. The shelves were spotless, and the windows had not been so clear in years.
Looking back, I had the order exactly upside down. I will book the same package again but reserve it several days ahead, since same-day slots are rarely open.

From: Godfrey Vickers, Client Accounts
To: Estelle Coyle
Date: August 14
Subject: Underhill year-end data handover
Dear Ms. Coyle,
Radcliffe Records Management is preparing to receive Underhill Consulting's year-end files, and our portal offers three upload routes for them. As the records coordinator who manages Underhill's document categories, you know better than I do how the files are grouped. Before we commit to one route, I would value your opinion on which suits your material best. I lean toward the Standard Portal Route. What appeals to me is following each batch as it is uploaded, rather than waiting for a summary afterward. I cannot view your files before they arrive, however, so your judgment matters here. Because the year-end review begins later on the handover day itself, every file must be in place before it starts, and the route we choose affects how early the upload must begin. For that reason, please confirm your choice by August 21.
Best regards,
Godfrey Vickers
Client Accounts, Radcliffe Records Management

Bulk Transfer Route	Large archives and scans	Scheduled overnight transfer	Very large sets	Runs unattended, report next morning

Around the Region
Museum Displays Head Out to Local Halls
By Alma Reichert
Ledbury Regional History Museum has extended its traveling display program to community halls and branch libraries across the district. "Most of these objects have never left this building," said Gordon Nasser, the museum's director of collections, "and the people they belong to should not have to travel to see them."
Each display travels in sealed crates and is delivered and collected by museum staff. Venues that take part agree to count visitors daily and report the total when the display is returned. Available displays are listed on the museum's Web site.
----------------------
Visit | Collections | Traveling Displays
Displays Available for Loan
Check each entry against your own room before requesting a display.
Display	Crates	Floor space	Maximum loan	Conditions
Village Schooling	2	55 square feet	2 weeks	●
Coins of the Valley	1	40 square feet	4 weeks	■
Valley Mills	4	100 square feet	4 weeks	●
Farm Tools and Harvest	2	45 square feet	4 weeks	●
■ Needs a room that can be closed and staffed during public hours.
● Needs a wall outlet near the display stand.
1. First-time borrowers are visited by museum staff before a display is sent. A venue that has hosted a display before may send current room measurements instead.
2. Each display is serviced for one week after every loan, and requested dates must allow for that.
----------------------
From: Ursula Wojcik
To: Traveling Displays Office
Date: October 9
Subject: Display loan for November
Attachment: Room measurements
Dear Traveling Displays Office,
Sedgefield Community Hall would like a display for the three weeks beginning November 18. Other bookings fill the hall before and after, so it must stay the full period.
Our display corner has 60 square feet of usable floor and wall outlets beside it, but no room here can be closed and staffed while visitors are present. I have attached our room measurements, so a survey visit should not be needed.
Our autumn talks concern the valley's mills, though any local subject would suit us. Which display can we take?
Ursula Wojcik
Program Coordinator
Sedgefield Community Hall
Messages reach me before 1:00 P.M.
